# Work templates

[Up: Documentation](../index.md)

These templates implement [Work assets](../engineering/work-assets.md). Replace placeholders; retain fields applicable to the approved work. No filled field or checked box is evidence by itself. Template text and proposed formats remain draft.

- [Schedule](schedule.md)
- [Issue](issue.md)
- [Plan](plan.md)
- [Design](design.md)
- [Completion review](completion-review.md)

The former proposed template filename for scheduled work is replaced with `issue.md` following the approved terminology decision. Existing plan output paths remain `docs/plans/<type>/<issue>-<name>.md`.
